title: Asthma smoke exposure boundary
summary: A boundary card for people with asthma or breathing sensitivity when wildfire smoke, building smoke, dust, ash, or cleaning fumes begin to affect indoor air.
content: Core sequence: 1) Follow the person’s written asthma plan and keep rescue medicine, spacer, and contact numbers together. 2) Move away from smoke or fumes early; do not wait until speech, walking, or sleep is affected. 3) Reduce indoor smoke entry by closing obvious gaps and stopping activities that add dust or chemical vapors. 4) Escalate immediately if breathing becomes hard, lips or face change color, medicine is unavailable, or symptoms do not improve as expected.
